dct_description_sm: Many Common Ravens (Corvus corax) are year-round residents of the North Slope. They nest singly on cliffs throughout the Brooks Range and foothills, but are also found in human settlements and developed areas such as the oil fields. In recent years, ravens have expanded their breeding range on the North Slope by using industrial facilities for nesting. Long term monitoring of raven nests around the North Slope oil production facilities.
dct_title_s: Raven Monitoring in Greater Prudhoe Bay, Alaska
